company.name: Bazaars
company.shortDescription: Blockchain network & mobile apps providing a decentralized P2P marketplace for users to exchange physical goods & assets for cryptocurrency.
company.description:
Bazaars will be a proof-of-stake (PoS) blockchain network and a decentralized peer-to-peer (P2P) marketplace. Users can exchange physical and digital assets with each other. They can also produce and deploy smart contracts and dapps individually or collectively, without an intermediary or third-party or the use of an incorporated entity.

Bazaars (BZR) token holders will receive a percentage of profits from the Bazaars app marketplace.
